studioLanding.intro: Bring together invoices, packing lists, bills of lading and related documents. Compare each field, retain its source and prepare data for your Excel template.
studioLanding.demoNote: Retain every source. Review before confirming.
studioLanding.workflowTitle: One workflow, with every source retained.
studioLanding.workflowIntro: Follow a case from incoming documents to consolidated values. Select a step to explore its purpose.

steps.title: Collect
steps.description: Group files belonging to the same shipment. A PDF may contain several logical documents: contract, invoice and packing list remain distinct sections.

steps.title: Read & verify
steps.description: Extract values with their documents and source locations. Uncertain values require verification before they can enter consolidated data.

steps.title: Compare
steps.detail: The same field, unit and transport leg.
steps.description: Normalize known units before comparison. Distinguish quantity from packages, net from gross, and shipped vessel from arrival vessel.

steps.title: Consolidate
steps.description: Choose values from verified sources. Retain change reasons and review history whenever documents differ.

steps.title: Export Excel
steps.detail: The right template and destination cells.
steps.description: Check readiness, template version and mapping before filling Excel. Required fields and source values must be reviewed before export.

studioLanding.examplesTitle: Different does not always mean wrong.
studioLanding.examplesIntro: Quantities, prices and transport legs need comparison in the right context. Select a case to inspect its review findings.

principles.title: Preserve original documents
principles.description: Every extracted value retains its source. Never change originals to make figures appear consistent.

principles.title: Do not guess for the reviewer
principles.description: Conflicting sources, missing documents and uncertain units require verification. AI assists reading and suggestions, not final business decisions.

principles.title: Export the reviewed selections
principles.description: Consolidate reviewed values into a versioned Excel template. This is internal preparation, not customs clearance or ECUS transmission.

studioLanding.closingDescription: Read sources, inspect differences and choose values in the workspace.
